before I go to play in the next tourney.

Messages.Author: PDB6
Messages.Body:
Raille wrote:
"Immortal Grapple: Can either minion in a immortal grapple steal or destroy
equipment. I assume that the answer is no, but would like verification before
I go to play in the next tourney."

While two minions are Immortally Grappled, they may only use hand strikes for
the entire combat. Nothing else. Any strike that is not a hand strike cannot
be used. This includes:

Strike: Steal/Destroy equipment
Dodge
Strike: Combat Ends
Weapons of any type (even ones that are based on a minions hand damage)
Thaumaturgy strikes (that aren't hand strikes)
Quiteus strikes (that aren't hand strikes)
anything that is not a hand strike.

Keep in mind that most Potence cards add to a minions hand damage, so are
useable (other than Thrown Sewer Lid/Gate/Car), including Torn Signpost (which
does nothing but set a vampires base hand damage at 2 or 3). Play Torn
Signpost, Fists of Death, Immortaly Grapple your foe, and strike with Undead
Strength for 7 hand damage. Then chuckle. Protean cards like Wolf Claws
modify a minions hand damage, so they are useable too, as are cards like
Kabhar-Honor and Lucky Blow, both of which modify a vampires hand damage.
Weapons, even hand damage based ones, like Sengir Dagger and Bastard Sword, are
not, as they are Weapon Strikes (doing damage based on your hand damage), and
not hand strikes.

So to directly answer your question, no, you cannot steal/destroy equipment
while Immortally Grappled, as it is not a Hand Strike. You can just punch
someone. Hopefully, you will be punching them for alot, and their equipment
will be useless anyway.
